statement: Functional evidence only. Hosted behaviour was not exercised (no hosted VM, SSH, broker sandbox, futures smoke, live order, real capital, or external provider call was run). Hosted verification belongs to INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.
review_p1_fixes: P1-1: Removed services.capital.capital_guard import from paper_runtime.py and added stdlib-only load_risk_policy, normalize_risk_policy, load_risk_policy_model, read_capital_pool_record, and resolve_bound_pool_risk_policy in services/capital/risk_policy.py so CheckServiceLockSharedDepsTests.test_repository_locks_cover_their_reachable_imports passes.

P1-2: Removed _DEFAULT_PAPER_RISK_POLICY_MAPPING and signal-metadata risk_policy/risk_policy_id overrides from paper_runtime.py and executor.py; bound pool risk_policy_ref is resolved via resolve_bound_pool_risk_policy and missing/unreadable policies fail closed with risk_gate_rejected (reason=risk_policy_unavailable).

P1-3: Enforced strict D-1 settlement date validation (price_date == previous_trading_day(trade_date, holidays)), removed default price_basis='futures_daily_settlement_prev_session' and market_price/limit_price/_iso_now() fallbacks for stock_future orders in EvaluateOrderRiskGate and SubmitTaiwanBrokerOrder, and forwarded candidate settlement metadata in executor.py.

P1-4: Updated EvaluateOrderRiskGate to treat sign-reversal orders (q_before * q_after < 0) as opening a new exposure leg (is_opening_or_increasing = abs(q_after) > abs(q_before) or (q_before * q_after < 0)), and aggregated single-name weight by underlying across cash shares and futures for max_single_name_weight checks.

P1-5: Made MarkFuturesSession and SettleExpiringFutures atomic, complete-mark validated, session-idempotent (_last_futures_mark_session_date and _settled_futures_contracts), and calendar-aware for next-trading-session forced liquidation, and wired process_futures_session/_maybe_process_futures_lifecycle into PaperRuntimeService.

P1-6: Extended _persist_state, _load_state, BindPerformanceBinding, positions, mark_symbols, apply_market_marks, performance_ledger, pnl, and value_portfolio to persist/restore open futures positions and margin/cost/PnL state and migrate legacy cash-only ledgers cleanly.

P1-7: Isolated futures marks and fills to instrument_id in _commit_futures_fill, MarkFuturesSession, and _publish so stock_future fills and session marks never overwrite the underlying cash security mark in Securities[symbol].

commands.covers: P1-1: reachable imports from services/execution/lean_runtime/paper_runtime.py are covered by services/execution/lean_runtime/requirements.lock without pulling pydantic via capital_guard

AC1-AC9 and P1-1..P1-7: mixed-book positions keyed by (persona_binding_id, normalised_underlying, instrument_id) holding eq:2330 and ssf:QFF:202611 without netting and reporting net_delta_shares; stock-future initial margin reservation (30334.5, 63990, 8700), maximum contracts (3, 1, 11 at QFF@2247, DHF@237, SRF@97.35 on 100,000 capital), realized/unrealized PnL and ledger reconciliation; bound pool risk policy resolution from CAPITAL_RISK_POLICY_DIR and fail-closed risk_policy_unavailable when missing/corrupt while ignoring signal metadata risk_policy overrides; strict D-1 settlement date check and rejection of stock close / market_price fallback; sign-reversal orders gated as opening new exposure and underlying-aggregated max_single_name_weight; SD section 8 replay table for E1, E2, E3 on 2330, 2317, 0050 (long and short); stock-future fill payload with price_basis='futures_daily_settlement_prev_session' and QFF open cost 9.494; November 2026 expiry settlement and settlement_pending guard; maintenance margin breach -> paper_margin_call and next-trading-session paper_forced_liquidation; MarkFuturesSession idempotency and PaperRuntimeService lifecycle hook; durable futures ledger reload, legacy cash-only ledger migration, and mixed-book mark isolation
acceptance 1-9 and P1-1..P1-7: full paper_runtime test suite including existing cash-share ledger, lifecycle recovery, performance telemetry, and futures ledger + order risk gate tests

acceptance 3, 5, 6, 8 and P1-1, P1-2, P1-3, P1-6: TAIFEX SSF fee schedule helpers, governed_twse_holidays, executor candidate metadata forwarding without risk_policy override, value_portfolio futures unrealized PnL valuation, and stdlib risk_policy loader + bound pool resolver
acceptance 5, 9: paper simulation futures fill metadata, signal consumer, bootstrap contract, runtime context, and smoke tests
acceptance 3, 5, 7: telemetry schema + ingest acceptance and trade-journey terminal non-fill projection for paper_futures_settled, paper_margin_call, and paper_forced_liquidation
